title: The Value-Sensitive Conversational Agent Co-Design Framework
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It proposes a framework for co-designing 'value-sensitive' conversational agents, where 'values' are elicited from stakeholders in a general sense, not specifically religious values.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion; therefore, there are no findings on this topic.
